generated_examples.rule: Each source row becomes one research-only example with the same official URL, fact, gate and confidence. No parcel relation, water connection capacity, electricity capacity reservation, nutrient conclusion or groundwater constraint is inferred.

extra_examples.fact: Current WRMP guidance requires at least a 25-year planning horizon.
extra_examples.gate: Long-term adequacy does not prove a specific development can connect now.

extra_examples.fact: Current guidance schedules company resource-position statements for 10 May 2027.
extra_examples.gate: Do not infer unpublished 2027 resource positions.

extra_examples.fact: Current guidance schedules draft WRMP29 submission for 1 February 2028.
extra_examples.gate: Future draft content is not current evidence.

extra_examples.fact: The statutory target is a 20% reduction in public-water-supply use per head by 2038 from the 2019-20 baseline.
extra_examples.gate: National efficiency targets are not local headroom.

extra_examples.fact: EA identifies 2025-26 as the first PR24/WRMP24 delivery year for most companies.
extra_examples.gate: Plan delivery status still requires current company evidence.

extra_examples.fact: Thames Water's WRMP24 looks ahead to 2075.
extra_examples.gate: Long-range planning does not prove local supply capacity.

extra_examples.fact: Thames Water forecasts roughly 1 billion additional litres per day may be needed by 2050.
extra_examples.gate: A regional deficit forecast cannot be converted into parcel rejection or approval.

extra_examples.fact: Anglian Water states WRMP24 demand and preferred-plan outputs were revised in April 2025 to align with PR24 baseline out-turns.
extra_examples.gate: Use the revised version rather than older WRMP24 tables.

extra_examples.fact: Anglian publishes separate WRMP24 planning-area and resource-zone summaries.
extra_examples.gate: A canonical parcel must first be matched to the correct water-resource zone.

extra_examples.fact: Southern Water states WRMP24 covers 2025 to 2075.
extra_examples.gate: Fifty-year planning is not a live local connection response.

extra_examples.fact: SES Water publishes a WRMP24 headroom assessment among its official supporting documents.
extra_examples.gate: Headroom must be tied to the exact resource zone and current network position.

extra_examples.fact: UKPN allows public catalogue browsing but says full data-table access may require free registration.
extra_examples.gate: No account is created and no account-gated capacity values are inferred.

extra_examples.fact: UKPN says LTDS is published at the end of May and November with a five-year view.
extra_examples.gate: A periodic planning snapshot is not a current connection offer.

extra_examples.fact: UKPN NDP uses network ratings and DFES scenarios to show potential headroom over time.
extra_examples.gate: Scenario headroom cannot be promoted as guaranteed capacity.

extra_examples.fact: UKPN real-time constraint metering can update every minute.
extra_examples.gate: Dynamic constraint headroom must be time-stamped and still does not create contractual capacity.

extra_examples.fact: NGED explicitly says its capacity map does not replace a full formal application.
extra_examples.gate: Map colours/headroom cannot be treated as a connection approval.

extra_examples.fact: The Network Opportunity Map requires free registration for full interactive access.
extra_examples.gate: No registration is performed; hidden map values are not inferred.

extra_examples.fact: NGED warns its network-capacity dataset may contain inaccuracies, omissions or out-of-date values.
extra_examples.gate: Independent verification is required before any capacity score.

extra_examples.fact: SSEN describes its capacity map as an indication of capability to connect large developments.
extra_examples.gate: Indicative capacity is not a formal offer.

extra_examples.fact: SSEN aggregates EV, heat-pump, solar and battery connections at primary-substation level.
extra_examples.gate: Installed LCT totals do not equal spare demand or generation headroom.

extra_examples.fact: SP Electricity North West directs prospective applicants to heat maps for available-capacity screening before applying.
extra_examples.gate: Heat-map screening does not reserve capacity.

extra_examples.fact: The May 2026 methodology distinguishes LTDS one-to-five-year and NDP one-to-ten-year planning views.
extra_examples.gate: Different horizons must not be mixed into a single live-capacity value.

extra_examples.fact: Planning Data reports 39 nutrient catchments but flags some MHCLG-created data pending authoritative replacement.
extra_examples.gate: Prefer authoritative Natural England entity geometry and current advice.

extra_examples.fact: Planning Data's groundwater source-protection-zone consideration remains in design screening rather than a production dataset.
extra_examples.gate: No parcel constraint is inferred from design-stage material.
